title: Prisoners freed early are returning to jail at rapid rate, governors tell BBC
description: PM Andy Burnham on Sunday announced changes to the next early release scheme - scheduled to start in October - which mean PC Harper's killers will stay in jail.

title: Eight killed and others missing after ferry capsizes off northern Cyprus
description: A search and rescue operation is under way after a ferry carrying nearly 270 people turns over after leaving port.

title: 'A giant leap forward': Nasa launches powerful new space telescope to explore mysteries of the Universe
description: The US space agency's telescope is starting a multi-year mission to create a new map of the universe and learn more about dark energy and dark matter.

title: Sons of officer who died in A66 crash lead out Man Utd as mascots
description: The sons of PC Matthew Blades led Manchester United out at Old Trafford for Sunday's Premier League game with Ipswich.

title: Church names pastor killed by falling sign at Christian festival
description: Robert Guanco, 41, was a pastor at Jesus the Living Water Church in Eastbourne, East Sussex.

title: British woman killed in stabbing at German railway station
description: A 27-year-old German man was arrested immediately after the incident in Rosenheim, Bavaria.

title: Iceland votes against restarting EU membership talks
description: Broadcaster RUV reports that 52.8% of voters rejected the government's proposal to resume accession talks.

title: Police release one of two men arrested over fatal house fire
description: Police continue to question a 23-year-old man over the fire in which a girl, 7, and her aunt died.

title: Woman injured in fatal police pursuit crash dies
description: She had been driving a car which was involved in a collision with an Audi being chased by police.
